sarah: Heads up — we have a scheduled pen test against staging next Tue 09:00 PT. Need KMS access window, RBAC snapshot, and evidence upload path. Can ops run a preflight runthrough?

 tom: Oncall here. What's the exact window and which roles will be granted ephemeral access?

 sarah: Target window 09:00-13:00 PT. We plan to hand out ephemeral assessor role (assessment-assessor) for 4 hours. Need KMS decrypt proxy with read-only wrap keys. Also want audit logs exported to the evidence bucket.

 liam: I can provide the RBAC snapshot script. Will run and upload to /evidence/pt-2026-03-staging. Also enable audit sampling. @natalie can you confirm telemetry retention for the window?

 natalie: Yes — we increase full request tracing retention to 30d for that window and export logs at +1h frequency to the evidence bucket. I'll add runbook steps. :white_check_mark:

 sarah: Great. Two quick asks: 1) KMS proxy — will we allow decrypt? 2) Evidence packaging format (manifest + signatures)?

 tom: We will proxy decrypt calls through kms-proxy limited to the assessor principal and only for specific keys. No signing allowed. We will provide signed presigned URLs for evidence upload.

 liam: RBAC snapshot command:

 ```
 # prints roles + policies for namespace staging
 kubectl get rolebindings -n staging -o yaml > rbacs/staging-snapshot.yaml
 aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(RoleName, `assessment`)]' > rbacs/aws-assessment-roles.json
 ```

 liam: I'll run this at T-1 day and push to the evidence path.

 sarah: For audit logs, we want unfiltered request traces and KMS audit events. Is our KMS logging routed through SIEM?

 natalie: Yes — KMS events go to our SIEM (splunk). For pen test we will also forward raw key-access logs to the evidence bucket with access ACL to security@redwood.com only.

 tom: Oncall checklist: 1) open ephemeral role; 2) enable kms-proxy; 3) add presigned upload URL; 4) monitor errors and throttling; 5) postmortem owner assigned.

 sarah: Who owns postmortem? I nominate liam + security.

 liam: ok +1. I'll be Postmortem lead and will collect evidence.

 deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: staging-pt-2026-03-xx — 09:00-13:00 PT. Ticket #INC-12345

 sarah: Thanks. Final note — can we run a quick dry-run next Wed 09:00 (30m) to validate RBAC + upload? If yes, mark as T-3 day.

 tom: Dry-run scheduled. I'll DM creds and presigned url to assessors after we verify RBAC.

 natalie: I'll attach a short runbook to the ticket and set an alert to watch for KMS proxy error rate >0.5%.

 sarah: Perfect. I'll update pen-test intake doc with these details and post followups. :thumbsup:
